subject: math

objective.text: Subtract measurements with the standard algorithm. Unbundle 1 hundred or 1 ten when you need more.

explanations.title: Check each place first
explanations.text: Before you subtract, look at each place. Are there enough ones? Enough tens? Enough hundreds?

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Part 2 (Students should unbundle all necessary digits before performing the operation.)

explanations.title: Unbundle a hundred
explanations.text: 825 minus 132: 2 tens is less than 3 tens. Unbundle 1 hundred into 10 tens. Now there are 7 hundreds and 12 tens.

explanations.title: A zero in the tens
explanations.text: 507 has 0 tens. To take away 4 tens, unbundle 1 hundred. 507 becomes 4 hundreds, 10 tens and 7 ones.

explanations.title: Answer with the unit
explanations.text: 825 milliliters minus 132 milliliters is 693 milliliters. Tara drank 693 milliliters.

examples.title: 825 mL minus 132 mL
examples.text: Ones: 5 minus 2 is 3. Tens: unbundle, 12 minus 3 is 9. Hundreds: 7 minus 1 is 6. Answer: 693 milliliters.

examples.title: 507 g minus 345 g
examples.text: Unbundle 1 hundred: 4 hundreds 10 tens 7 ones. 7 minus 5 is 2. 10 minus 4 is 6. 4 minus 3 is 1. Answer: 162 grams.

questions.text: Round each number to the nearest ten. About how much is 38 plus 23?
Tara has a bottle with 471 milliliters and a bottle with 354 milliliters. How many milliliters does she bring?
825 minus 132. Can you take 3 tens from 2 tens?
Unbundle 1 hundred from 8 hundreds 2 tens. How many hundreds and tens do you have now?
Tara had 825 milliliters. She has 132 milliliters left. How much did she drink?
508 milliliters minus 225 milliliters equals what number?
Nooran buys 507 grams of grapes on Tuesday and 345 grams on Thursday. How many more grams on Tuesday?
506 milliliters minus 435 milliliters equals what number?
307 grams minus 130 grams equals what number?
2 kilometers 770 meters minus 1 kilometer 455 meters. What is left?
The Lost Ship is 117 minutes. Champions is 22 minutes shorter. How long is Champions?
A rope is 208 centimeters long. It is cut into 3 pieces. Two pieces are 80 and 94 centimeters. How long is the third piece?
A banner is 408 centimeters long. Two sections are 187 centimeters together. How long is the third section?
Describe the steps of the standard algorithm for subtraction.
